brief: Draw a topology figure titled "Branch office WAN uplinks". A branch site has two access switches, each connected to a single branch router. The branch router carries a primary WAN link to a regional hub router and a separate backup WAN link to a second, diverse-path regional hub router. Use these ids: access1, access2, branch, hubprimary, hubbackup. Show the four links the description implies: access1 to branch, access2 to branch, branch to hubprimary, and branch to hubbackup.
